import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()

    # Preserve original row order
    orders = orders.reset_index(drop=True)
    orders["_orig_order"] = orders.index

    # Guard against duplicate keys in reference tables: keep first occurrence
    ref_customers = ref_customers.drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="first")
    ref_skus = ref_skus.drop_duplicates(subset="sku", keep="first")

    # Merge with indicators to detect presence/absence of reference rows
    merged = orders.merge(
        ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]],
        on="customer_id",
        how="left",
        indicator="_cust_ind",
    )
    merged = merged.merge(
        ref_skus[["sku", "discontinued", "allowed_countries"]],
        on="sku",
        how="left",
        indicator="_sku_ind",
    )

    def country_blocked(allowed_countries, ship_country):
        if pd.isna(allowed_countries):
            return False
        text = str(allowed_countries).strip()
        if text == "":
            return False
        members = [m.strip() for m in text.split(",")]
        return ship_country not in members

    def classify(row):
        # R1: customer unknown
        if row["_cust_ind"] == "left_only":
            return "CUST_UNKNOWN"
        # R2: customer status not ACTIVE
        status = row["status"]
        if pd.isna(status) or status != "ACTIVE":
            return "CUST_INACTIVE"
        # R3: sku unknown
        if row["_sku_ind"] == "left_only":
            return "SKU_UNKNOWN"
        # R4: sku discontinued
        disc = row["discontinued"]
        try:
            disc_flag = int(disc) if not pd.isna(disc) else 0
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            disc_flag = 0
        if disc_flag == 1:
            return "SKU_DISC"
        # R5: country blocked
        if country_blocked(row["allowed_countries"], row["ship_country"]):
            return "CTRY_BLOCKED"
        return None

    merged["reason_code"] = merged.apply(classify, axis=1)

    orig_cols = [c for c in orders.columns if c != "_orig_order"]

    clean_mask = merged["reason_code"].isna()
    rejects_mask = ~clean_mask

    orders_clean = (
        merged.loc[clean_mask, ["_orig_order"] + orig_cols]
        .sort_values("_orig_order")
        .drop(columns="_orig_order")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    orders_rejects = (
        merged.loc[rejects_mask, ["_orig_order"] + orig_cols + ["reason_code"]]
        .sort_values("_orig_order")
        .drop(columns="_orig_order")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects,
    }
